_comment: Recorded budgets for a STOCK build of build/core/dos_core.elf. Checked by scripts/budget_gate.py; write with --update. RAISING A NUMBER HERE IS THE REVIEW -- the commit that raises it must say what grew and why. See scripts/common/budgets.py for what each one means and what the frame count is and is not.

It is what makes Loom's F5 save/load screen readable: the game programs the attribute palette 00-07,10-17 and drew its text in near-black. Tier 2: guest_ram_pages 151. Tier 2: guest_ram_pages 151 (0x24067F70 measured 151 earlier). Prior note: 2026-10-17 on ega-full-card, stock flags, forced re-link. Tier 2: guest_ram_pages 151 (0x24067F00 sits below 0x24067F70, which measured 151 on gw-frontend). Prior note: 2026-10-17 on ega-full-card, stock flags, forced re-link. RAM_EMU 604405560 -> 604405272 (-288 B net): the sampler, the policy basis and the EGA2 claim cost ~480 B, paid by the DOS file-call log 96 -> 48 slots (-768 B). Tier 2 KEEN4: card 65,536 offsets in play (was 35,840), world map renders whole, guest_ram_pages 151. Prior note: 2026-10-17 on gw-frontend, stock flags, forced re-link. INT 15h AH=86h (BIOS wait) ANSWERED as a guest-clock advance (x86_pit_advance_us) raised RAM_EMU 604405480 -> 604405560 (+80 B). It is what lets Monkey Island (VGA) find its AdLib: the game times the OPL timer test with three 976 us waits and ignores CF. Tier 2: guest_ram_pages 151 (unchanged), x86_opl_timer_expiry 1, music writes climbing. Prior note: 2026-10-17 on gw-frontend, stock flags, forced re-link. SPEAKER EVENTS STAMPED IN GUEST TIME (x86_io_time_ms = x86_pit_ticks instead of HAL_GetTick) raised RAM_EMU 604405456 -> 604405480 (+24 B): the init call. Tier 2: guest_ram_pages 151 (unchanged). Prior note: 2026-10-17 on gw-frontend, stock flags, forced re-link. MONKEY ISLAND BOOT FIX: ITCM 62152 -> 62200 (+48 B) for the SS interrupt shadow in L(SET_SREG) (assembled in both operand-size passes); RAM_EMU 604405312 -> 604405456 (+144 B) for the mid-frame tick re-plan in src/main.c and the divisor-change exit in x86_io.c. Tier 2 re-measured: guest_ram_pages 151 (unchanged). Prior note: 2026-10-17 on gw-frontend, stock flags, forced re-link. OSK DISK MENU (the "A:" cap: list the other .dsk in the title's folder, remount the chosen one) + THREE-STATE SHIFT (next key / locked / off) raised RAM_EMU 604405096 -> 604405312 (+216 B net). Gross it was +1,232 B of code (dsk_walk/x86_osk_disk_* in src/main.c, the menu mode in x86_osk.c, x86_dos_disk_changed) and that MEASURED one guest frame at tier 2 (guest_ram_pages 151 -> 150: the pool is claimed in 4 KB steps, so the real slack was far below the gate's implied bound). Paid back by moving the menu's name table + path (~740 B) to the AHB heap, allocated on first open, and parse_batch()'s static 1 KB AUTOEXEC buffer onto the stack (launch-only, two levels at most). Tier 2 re-measured: guest_ram_pages 151, 622592 B free at claim, as before. Prior note: 2026-10-16 on gw-frontend, stock flags, forced re-link. OSK RELABELLED TO THE XTulator CORE'S LAYOUT (mixed-case labels, capital letters, arrow glyphs after Spc, a ':' cap that is Shift+';' in one press) raised RAM_EMU 604405088 -> 604405096 (+8 B): the A_KEY_SHIFT case in osk_press; the tables are no larger (19+19+19+18 caps against 20+19+20+18). Folding the case into osk_send was tried and measured +16. The implied frame bound did NOT move (151). Prior note: 2026-10-14 on gw-frontend, stock flags, forced re-link. FOUR-ROW BLUE-KEY OSK + retro-go in-game HUD raised RAM_EMU 604405048 -> 604405088 (+40 B): the new layout (one table of 4 QWERTY rows instead of 3 layers x 2) is about the same size as the old one; the colour map (16-entry CGA table, nearest search for 256-colour modes), the nearest-cap row step and x86_video_ui_colour() are the rest, minus the dropped status line. The implied frame bound did NOT move (151). Prior note: 2026-10-14 on gw-frontend, stock flags, forced re-link. EGA RE-SEAT (x86_vga_ega_reseat) raised RAM_EMU 604404920 -> 604405048 (+128 B, code only): the runtime card refit now carries plane bytes and registers across instead of re-arming through the mode-set path. The implied frame bound did NOT move (151). Prior note: 2026-10-14 on gw-frontend, stock flags, forced re-link. THE INT 33h MOUSE DRIVER (x86_mouse.c) COSTS THE GUEST ONE PAGER FRAME. RAM_EMU 604403192 -> 604404920 (+1,728 B): x86_mouse.o is 1,232 B text + 53 B bss (driver state and the INT 33h functions), the rest is `mouse = on` / click pseudo-keys in x86_pad.c, mouse_steer/x86_osk_mouse_drive and the driver-cursor path in x86_osk.c, and ~60 B of glue in src/main.c and x86_hle.c. Already -Os; no ITCM code, ITCM did not move. It is what makes the SCUMM titles playable at all (Loom's difficulty screen cannot be passed without a mouse driver; measured in gwemu). The implied bound goes 152 -> 151. Prior note: 2026-10-14 on gw-frontend, stock flags, forced re-link. .COM LOADING in x86_dos.c (dos_load_com) raised RAM_EMU 604402736 -> 604403192 (+456 B, code only). The implied frame bound did NOT move (152). Prior note: 2026-10-14 on gw-frontend, stock flags, forced re-link. THE [gamepad] SECTION (x86_pad.c) COSTS THE GUEST ONE PAGER FRAME -- do not update past this without reading why. RAM_EMU 604399848 -> 604402736: part of it was ALREADY over before this branch (october_latest's 'checkpoint' commit left __CORE_BSS_END__ at 0x24066a98, +432 B over the recorded 0x240668E8, and ITCM at 0xF2C8, +32 B over 62120 -- that ITCM figure is not from this branch, which adds no ITCM code); the rest is x86_pad.o, 2,027 B text + 114 B bss (key names, the parser, combos and the repeat state) plus ~150 B of glue in src/main.c. Trimmed once: letters, digits and F1..F12 are computed from the keyboard rows instead of listed and the name table is one packed string (3,216 -> 2,456 B over october_latest). The implied bound goes 153 -> 152 and the measured tier-2 pool 152 -> 151 (guest_ram_pages 0x97). The SDK re-sync to retro-go-sd external_cores in the same branch moved NEITHER number. Prior note: 2026-09-02 on agent/x87, stock flags, forced re-link. THE X87 ESCAPE GROUP (x86_x87.c + the rewritten .op_esc_x87) raised BOTH numbers, and the RAM one COSTS THE GUEST A PAGER FRAME -- do not update past this without reading why. ITCM 61704 -> 62088 (+384 B): the handler folds the operand, picks the read or write trap from a per-escape store mask and calls into C; it is OP_AGNOSTIC but an agnostic handler's BODY is still assembled in both operand-size passes, so the cost is doubled. RAM_EMU 604396184 -> 604399848 (+3664 B): x86_x87.o is 2,672 B of text, 10 B data and 71 B bss, plus the libgcc int64<->double helpers the FILD m64 / FISTP m64 forms pull in; dos_core.ld puts .text AND .rodata in RAM_EMU, so code IS frames. That takes the implied frame bound 154 -> 153. Two trims were tried and measured: replacing the integer casts in x87_round_int with the 2^52 add/subtract removed __aeabi_d2lz/__floatdidf from the rounding path, and -Os on x86_x87_exec made the object 4 B LARGER and was reverted. The x87 state is a file-static, NOT a member of X86CPUState, so DTCM did not move at all. Prior note: 2026-09-02 on agent/sb-adpcm, stock flags, forced re-link. RAM raised 604395336 -> 604396184 (+848 B) by the Creative ADPCM decoder in x86_io.c: 240 B of const step/adjust tables plus ~608 B of code. THE CORE IS A FLAT BLOB IN RAM_EMU -- dos_core.ld puts .text AND .rodata there -- so there is no flash to move the tables to. Nothing entered .bss beyond 8 bytes of decoder state in the static sbp struct, ITCM did NOT move (0xF108 either side), and the frame bound stayed at 154. Prior note: 2026-09-02 on agent/opcodes-bits, stock flags, forced re-link. ITCM raised 59696 -> 61704 (+2008 B) by the 0F bit and double-shift set: BT/BTS/BTR/BTC (A3/AB/B3/BB), BSF/BSR (BC/BD) and SHLD/SHRD (A4/A5/AC/AD), ten opcodes emitted TWICE (one pass per operand size). RAM and the frame bound did NOT move -- none of it touches .bss.
